# BS-Breath

**Aliases:** Respiration Sensing with Cell-free Massive MIMO

An open respiration-sensing dataset collected with a 64-antenna cell-free massive-MIMO testbed, providing uplink CSI at 3.51 GHz for 10 subjects with synchronized motion-capture respiration ground truth.
